answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mesa of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The ledge holds work receipts rather than names, so the quill of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
